title: Wider spans remove a layer
caption: With the same 64 staff below the chief executive, a span of 4 needs three levels and a span of 8 needs two. Each level multiplies by the span, so widening spans is the arithmetic behind delayering.
alt: Columns for a span of 4 (tall, three levels) and a span of 8 (flatter, two levels). Both reach 64 staff at the bottom.
description: Span of 4: 4 + 16 + 64, three levels below the chief executive.
In both, the bottom level is span to the power of the number of levels: 4³ = 8² = 64.

relations.name: 4 + 16 + 64 = 84 people in all below the chief executive
